adjudication.rationale: The diff adds PUT /admin/customize/embedding (routes.rb) implemented by Admin::EmbeddingController#update, but that action does not read any params or persist anything; it only re-renders the current @embedding (embedding_controller.rb). On the frontend, admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6 defines a saveChanges action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which would hit that no-op endpoint if invoked. Even if the current template (admin/templates/embedding.hbs) doesn’t wire up `saveChanges`, the API surface is misleading: it advertises an update capability that isn’t implemented.
